## Context / Problem
The shared git-backed tickets store has chronically wedged under parallel multi-session writes. Proven chain (RCA on 6ccc-0577-198c-44fa, live recurrence on e72e-259d-5ee7-4e73): the operation-linked compaction sweep (rebar._commands.compact_trigger.maybe_compact -> detached worker -> compact_txn._compact_locked) mutates the worktree (SNAPSHOT write, *.retired renames, .archived deletions) BEFORE its git commit, with no rollback on worker death. The leftover dirty tree then makes rebar._store.sync._union_merge's `git merge origin/tickets` abort in two variants: (a) untracked files origin wants to create (recovered by Gerrit change 1757, ticket small-delicious-loris), and (b) tracked-file deletions/modifications ("Your local changes ... would be overwritten") — unhandled. The abort strands local ticket commits off origin (P0 data-loss risk) and the dirty tree breaks every plan-review/close attestation (strict `git status --porcelain` head check). Root residue: 119 `*/.archived` and 126 `*/.write.lock` runtime markers are TRACKED in HEAD (committed before their gitignore patterns existed; gitignore never un-tracks), so routine marker churn shows as tracked dirt forever. Interim mitigation active: user-config compact.trigger=off (recorded on e72e-259d-5ee7-4e73).

This epic makes the store wedge-PROOF (the dirty state is never produced), SELF-HEALING (sync and push recover the known abort classes in place), OPERATOR-REPAIRABLE (fsck detects the class, doctor repairs it under the write lock), and SCALABLE (store-wide scans default to active tickets, with an override flag reaching archived ones).

## Child decomposition (responsibilities, dependency-ordered)
- **Untrack per-ticket runtime markers** (`*/.archived`, `*/.write.lock`) from the tickets branch via an idempotent ensure unit, and make the reader self-heal a missing marker cache — removes the tracked-dirt class at its source; first because every later recovery then only faces untracked artifacts.
- **Crash-atomic compaction fold** (bug compulsory-pernickety-mantis): the fold commits as one unit with rollback on failure, plus a sweep-start crash-recovery preamble that reverts an abandoned partial fold under the write lock — the dirty tree is never produced. Discrimination of the two half-fold states is by an INTENT JOURNAL (a commit-pending sentinel): before its first worktree mutation the fold writes an intent record (ticket id, snapshot path, folded source list) OUTSIDE the worktree (under the tracker's git dir, so the sentinel itself can never be tree dirt), and removes it on every completed outcome — after the fold's commit succeeds, AND on the `_retire_folded_sources` failure paths (both the clean-rollback return and the intentionally-retained SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT state it keeps for `fsck --repair-snapshots`). The recovery preamble therefore reverts ONLY when it finds a live journal whose recorded snapshot is still uncommitted (rename `*.retired` sources back, unlink the uncommitted snapshot, unstage the ticket dir); a journal whose snapshot is already in HEAD means the crash hit between commit and journal removal, so recovery just discards the journal; and the retained SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT state has NO journal by construction, so the preamble never touches it — `fsck --repair-snapshots` remains its sole owner.
- **Reconverge tracked-artifact recovery** (variant b): `_union_merge` also recovers the "local changes would be overwritten" abort for store-artifact paths (restore worktree-deleted tracked files from HEAD, quarantine modified ones), retry once — depends on change 1757's untracked-path quarantine landing (ticket small-delicious-loris).
- **Push-recovery parity** (bug sulfuryl-suicidal-osprey): the non-fast-forward push recovery path gets the same untracked-collision + tracked-deletion recovery as reconverge.
- **fsck detection + doctor repair**: `rebar fsck` reports the dirty-tree/stale-lock class (tracked deletions, untracked regenerable leftovers, orphaned locks, orphaned .tmp-event-*); `rebar doctor --repair` heals what is safe under the write lock (restore, quarantine, reclaim), never touching `.tmp-event-*` content.
- **Active-only scan scoping**: store-wide walks (fsck scan, compact-all sweep) default to non-archived tickets and accept `--include-archived` to reach the full store, so scan cost tracks the ACTIVE working set as the store grows.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A compaction fold interrupted at any point between its first worktree mutation and its commit leaves the tracker tree clean after the next sweep or doctor run; proxy: kill-mid-fold unit test asserts `git status --porcelain` is empty post-recovery.
- [ ] A reconverge facing EITHER abort variant on regenerable store artifacts completes the union merge keeping both parents, with no local commit orphaned; proxy: RED->GREEN tests for both variants in tests/unit.
- [ ] `git ls-files '*/.archived' '*/.write.lock'` in the tracker returns empty after the ensure unit runs, and marker add/remove churn no longer appears in `git status`; proxy: ensure-unit test on a fixture store seeded with tracked markers.
- [ ] `rebar fsck` names each dirty-tree/stale-lock finding class and `rebar doctor --repair` heals a seeded wedge end-to-end; proxy: integration test seeds all classes and asserts clean status + converged merge afterward.
- [ ] `rebar fsck` and `rebar compact-all` default to active tickets and reach archived ones only with `--include-archived`; proxy: test on a fixture with archived+active tickets counts visited dirs both ways.
- [ ] The interim user-config `compact.trigger=off` mitigation is removed once the crash-atomicity child closes; proxy: closing comment on e72e-259d-5ee7-4e73 records the removal.
